scenarios.title: The Family Financial Decision
scenarios.text: You and {love_interest} disagree about a major purchase.

choices.label: Let {love_interest} decide
choices.result: You let {love_interest} decide. It's the right call.

choices.label: Sleep on it
choices.result: You agree to wait a month. The decision makes itself.

choices.label: Make your case
choices.result: You make your case. You win, and the house is quiet for a day.

scenarios.title: The Teammate's Contract
scenarios.text: A young teammate is in his first big negotiation and comes to your locker with the offer folded in his pocket. He wants to know what you'd do.

choices.label: Tell him what you learned
choices.result: You tell him everything you learned, including the mistakes that cost you. He takes notes on a napkin and gets a better deal than yours.

choices.label: Introduce your agent
choices.result: You introduce him to your agent over lunch. It goes well, and he thanks you in the locker room loudly enough to embarrass you both.

choices.label: Tell him to trust his agent
choices.result: You tell him to trust his agent and not to read the comments. It's good advice, and he looks like he wanted more.

scenarios.title: The Offseason Commitment
scenarios.text: Your family wants you home; your training plan doesn't agree.

choices.label: Go home
choices.result: You go home and train in the park. Everyone's happy.

choices.label: Stick to the plan
choices.result: You stick to the plan. Home waits.

choices.label: Bring them to you
choices.result: You bring the family to your training city for a month.

scenarios.title: The Hall of Fame Conversation
scenarios.text: A broadcaster asks, on air, whether you ever think about your legacy. It's a soft question, and it lands harder than he meant it to.

choices.label: Give an honest answer
choices.result: You say you think about the next kick, which is true. Later, in the car, you think about the question for a long time.

choices.label: Talk about the people
choices.result: You talk about the people who got you here: {parent}, your first coach, the holders. The clip is the one your family keeps.

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.result: You laugh and say you'll worry about it when you're old. Your teammates tease you about it, and the question stays with you.

scenarios.title: The Young Kicker's Arrival
scenarios.text: A rookie asks to learn your routine, step by step.

choices.label: Teach him
choices.result: You teach him every step. Then you teach him why.

choices.label: Let him shadow you
choices.result: You let him shadow you for a week.

choices.label: Keep some secrets
choices.result: You teach him most of it. A few things are yours.

scenarios.title: The Business Reputation
scenarios.text: A customer's angry post about your business has been shared all over town, with your face in the picture. Your name is on the sign, so it's your problem now.

choices.label: Fix the problem
choices.result: You find out what actually went wrong, fix it, and say so publicly in plain words. A few people unfollow, more come back, and the manager stops dreading Mondays.

choices.label: Call the customer
choices.result: You call the customer yourself. They don't believe it's you at first, then talk for twenty minutes. Their next post is about the phone call.

choices.label: Let the managers handle it
choices.result: You leave it to the managers. They handle it fine, slowly, and for a month people bring it up whenever they recognize you.

scenarios.title: The Team's Community Day
scenarios.text: You're asked to organize the club's charity day.

choices.label: Run it
choices.result: You run it. It's the best one the club has had.

choices.label: Bring the families
choices.result: You bring the players' families in. It becomes a tradition.

choices.label: Help where needed
choices.result: You help where you're needed and let the staff lead.

scenarios.title: The Family Milestone
scenarios.text: A major family occasion falls on a game weekend.

choices.label: Make it work
choices.result: You fly in Friday night and out Saturday morning.

choices.label: Stay with the team
choices.result: You stay with the team and call during dinner.

choices.label: Plan a second celebration
choices.result: You plan a second celebration for the bye week.

scenarios.title: The Old Teammate's Request
scenarios.text: A former teammate is starting a business and asks you to back him. He's earnest, he's prepared, and he's never run anything in his life.

choices.label: Back it with conditions
choices.result: You back it with conditions, a lawyer and a quarterly meeting. He grumbles about the paperwork and thanks you for it later.

choices.label: Back him fully
choices.result: You back him fully, because he's your friend. It's a risk, and he calls after every small win like a kid with a report card.

choices.label: Say no
choices.result: You say no, kindly. He understands, mostly, and you both pretend at the next reunion that it didn't change anything.

scenarios.title: The Next Chapter Conversation
scenarios.text: {love_interest} wants to know what you picture for life after football.

choices.label: Picture it together
choices.result: You picture it together. It sounds good.

choices.label: Make a list
choices.result: You each make a list. They overlap more than you thought.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.result: You say you're not there yet. {love_interest} waits.

scenarios.title: Contract Year: The Middle Years
scenarios.text: A contract year in your thirties means proving you're not slowing down.

choices.label: Train like a rookie
choices.result: You train like a rookie all summer.

choices.label: Show the numbers
choices.result: You show the club your numbers. They're as good as ever.

choices.label: Stay calm at home
choices.result: You keep it calm at home. The contract will come or it won't.

scenarios.title: Doubts at Thirty
scenarios.text: A slump in your thirties, and the questions are about your age, not your form.

choices.label: Find the real cause
choices.result: You find the real cause in the film. It's your plant foot, not your age.

choices.label: Kick through it
choices.result: You kick through it.

choices.label: Lean on {holder}
choices.result: You lean on {holder}. They've seen this before.

choices.label: Use the tools you learned
choices.result: You use the tools you learned the first time. The slump is shorter.

scenarios.title: The Thirty-Something Streak
scenarios.text: A month without a miss, and the stories say you're better than ever.

choices.label: Stay in your routine
choices.result: You stay in your routine and don't read anything.

choices.label: Share it with the unit
choices.result: You share it with the unit. They earned it too.

choices.label: Enjoy it quietly
choices.result: You enjoy it quietly at home.
